reason: Every draconic bloodline grants the "Draconic Defenses" of its dragon's energy type, so each copy has several colours as grantors (acid: black, copper, green; cold: silver, white; electricity: blue, bronze; fire: brass, gold, red), all with the same family name. The copies differ only in their energy, which the asset names DragonicDefencesAcid, Cold, Electricity and Fire state; each is qualified by it.
